protocol.user_sampling: independent uniform eligible users with replacement for each branch
protocol.intervention_scope: Only nonterminal cutoff probabilities differ for histories longer than 12 events. Prefix length and target exposure can consequently change.
protocol.matched_control_status: Unverified: supplied aggregate scores do not establish matched control execution. This invocation trains only its selected policy.
protocol.policy_coverage_definition: Both cutoff inverse CDFs use each terminal example's same original uniform without additional RNG draws. Changed occurrence counts compare event indices; changed item counts compare item IDs, so repeated items can have changed occurrences but unchanged labels. These are sampling audits, not validation treatment effects.
protocol.patience_unit: epochs since earliest best checkpoint; checked at validation
protocol.normalization: separate means over all valid targets in each branch

output_head.denominator: all real items 1..itemnum; PAD and MASK excluded
output_head.reduction: summed CE divided by branch valid-target count

protocol.reconstruction: latest maxlen events; 0.15 MASK-only with one-target fallback
protocol.terminal_context: at most maxlen-1 preceding events followed by MASK

epoch_branch_metrics.objective_definition: Mean over updates of 0.5 times reconstruction target-mean CE plus 0.5 times terminal target-mean CE. Reconstruction target counts vary across updates; global target-weighted CE cannot reconstruct this mean batch objective.

cumulative_branch_metrics.coefficient_mass_definition: sum of target coefficients across updates; neither loss-value share nor gradient share

terminal_draw_fraction_definition: Cumulative fraction of terminal examples drawn from histories where recent10 and uniform have different nonterminal probabilities; includes endpoint draws, whose probability remains unchanged.

run_summary.comparison_status: Unverified: supplied aggregate scores do not establish matched control execution. This invocation trains only its selected policy.
